message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts and correction lessons.

Facts: Person without medical qualification performed fetal sex determination (non-medical need) and then performed illegal abortion (selective gender termination). Also provided abortion medication, charged fee. This is illegal sex-selective abortion. According to correction lessons: "非法进行节育手术" is correct label for illegal sex-selective abortion (selective termination). The lesson says: "关键在于行为本身是未经许可的节育手术（选择性别的引产），属于《刑法》规定的非法进行节育手术，而不是单纯的非法行医或非法堕胎。" So label should be 【非法进行节育手术】.

Also possibly "非法行医" but correction says not. So only that label.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法进行节育手术<eoa>
